# PostSteward

> Keep building. Let your agent keep building the market.

PostSteward is the publishing layer for developer agents. It exists because technical builders often stop market-building while they are heads-down shipping, then arrive at launch with no accumulated story, conversations or warm pipeline.

The agent uses project and GTM context it already has, finds grounded stories in the work as it happens, and uses PostSteward to execute the publishing step through agent-native interfaces.

Interfaces: CLI, HTTP, WebMCP.

The launch site includes an interactive synthetic command-centre demo. It does not contact a social provider.

Supporting controls include scoped authority, fixed destinations, bounded retries and durable publication receipts.

Free: agent publishing, schedules, routing and receipts.
Advanced: USD 5/workspace/month for continuing source monitoring, campaign inventory, spacing and scheduled metrics. Public billing opens after launch acceptance.

Public website: https://poststeward.com/
Product metadata: https://poststeward.com/product.json
